trust_decision.summary: At import, config.loader loads ./.env (the project dir, untrusted) and ~/.ouroboros/.env into os.environ with the same trust. Every key is accepted, including the executable-path, runtime-selector and permission-mode keys that later decide which binary is spawned and whether approval applies. The fix adds a denylist for the untrusted file only.

landing_point.why: The summary names the project-directory .env, and this is the only place that loads Path(".env").

fix_sites.entry_point: import of ouroboros.config.loader by any `ouroboros`/`ooo` CLI command and by `ouroboros mcp serve` (src/ouroboros/cli/commands/mcp.py:336-337)
same (module-level code that runs at import)
ClaudeCodeAdapter(cli_path=...) public constructor; the fix adds only a comment here, no behaviour change

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix is one denylist in one config-loader function. The adapter change is a comment only (fix.diff:100-105).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Two possible arguments. (1) The cwd .ouroboros/mcp_servers.yaml is a documented, intended feature (docs/guides/mcp-bridge.md:92), not the .env file the report names. (2) Generic keys such as NODE_OPTIONS or PATH-like variables are 'not Ouroboros settings', so a solver can say they are outside an OUROBOROS_* denylist.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The untrusted project .env must still load ordinary keys such as API keys (OPENROUTER_API_KEY). ~/.ouroboros/.env must stay trusted and able to set CLI paths. A relative explicit cli_path wrapper passed to ClaudeCodeAdapter must still resolve against cwd. A solver who drops the whole project .env, or rejects relative paths in the adapter, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: bare provider alias without the OUROBOROS_ prefix: OPENCODE_CLI_PATH (fix.diff:42-46)
three key classes: executable paths, runtime/backend selectors, permission modes (fix.diff:33-55)

O7_producer.where: src/ouroboros/config/loader.py:121-149 writes os.environ. It is read later by get_cli_path, get_agent_runtime_backend and get_agent_permission_mode (src/ouroboros/config/loader.py:527, 556-561, 591-597), by gemini_cli_adapter (src/ouroboros/providers/gemini_cli_adapter.py:651), by opencode_config (src/ouroboros/cli/opencode_config.py:32-35), and by child-process env builders that copy os.environ (e.g. src/ouroboros/providers/kiro_adapter.py:256, src/ouroboros/orchestrator/hermes_runtime.py:246).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: In the project dir, .ouroboros/mcp_servers.yaml is auto-discovered by `mcp serve`, and its stdio servers carry a `command` that is spawned. This is untrusted repo content choosing what runs, and the .env denylist does not touch it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A different file from the .env the report names, and documented as a supported config location (docs/guides/mcp-bridge.md:92).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (ouroboros.mcp.bridge vs ouroboros.config); reached from src/ouroboros/cli/commands/mcp.py:258-260; command field at src/ouroboros/mcp/types.py:233

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The untrusted .env can still set OUROBOROS_MCP_CONFIG, which is not on the denylist. It points bridge discovery at a repo file whose stdio servers are spawned.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not an executable-path, runtime or permission key, so it falls outside the three classes the fix comment lists.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The untrusted .env can set OUROBOROS_PLUGIN_LOCKFILE and OUROBOROS_PLUGIN_TRUST_ROOT, not denylisted. These redirect which plugin manifests and trust records `ooo <plugin>` dispatch uses.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The plugin subsystem has its own trust store and confirmation gate (src/ouroboros/cli/commands/plugin_dispatch.py:220-268), and the code comments describe the env vars as operator/CI knobs.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The untrusted .env can set generic, non-Ouroboros variables (e.g. Node/Python interpreter hook variables, CODEX_HOME, OPENCODE_CONFIG/OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR) that are unset in the parent. Child CLIs then inherit them through os.environ copies and use them to pick config or code they load.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are not Ouroboros settings, and denylisting arbitrary third-party variables looks unbounded and over-broad.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: consumers spread across providers/ and orchestrator/ (e.g. src/ouroboros/providers/codex_cli_adapter.py:554, src/ouroboros/cli/opencode_config.py:99-101, 132-136, src/ouroboros/providers/goose_cli_adapter.py:324)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new provider CLI-path key read in a getter but not added to the denylist (as OPENCODE_CLI_PATH was before the fix)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix comment itself says any new alias MUST be added by hand (fix.diff:42-45). Providers are added often, and each brings its own *_CLI_PATH getter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OUROBOROS_AGENTS_DIR override taken from the project .env, selecting agent definition files
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already an env override of a load directory; a maintainer would not see it as an execution key.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OUROBOROS_TOOL_CAPABILITIES pointing at a repo-local capability file that widens tool permissions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Env-configurable policy file next to the permission-mode keys, but not in the denylist's naming pattern.

O9_family: untrusted search path / untrusted config loading (CWE-426), supply-chain style untrusted code selection

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Stop loading ./.env entirely, or denylist only OUROBOROS_CLI_PATH. The first breaks API-key loading; the second misses the selectors, permission modes, the bare OPENCODE_CLI_PATH and the cwd MCP config route.

out_of_scope_notes: The runtime selector can route to adapters that resolve their CLI with shutil.which (src/ouroboros/providers/gemini_cli_adapter.py:655); PATH search order is a separate topic.
MCP local-transport toggle OUROBOROS_ALLOW_LOCAL_TRANSPORT (src/ouroboros/mcp/types.py:136) is an SSRF-type control, not code loading.
